title: Toon Tools
description: Toon Tools gives Minecraft’s tools bold black outlines, simplified colors, and exaggerated shapes for a clean, readable cartoon style.
body:
### Support me

       

--- ### Information **Toon Tools** is a texture pack I made to make the tools look more cartoony while still resembling the original tool shapes. It uses more basic colors and exaggerated shapes to keep the style fun without going over the top. **Note:** This pack may not work on servers if tool models are changed. Some textures require model adjustments, so if a server’s resource pack overrides item models, the pack may not work correctly. --- ### Trailer
